correctness.rationale: The hub-plus-uniform-periphery invariant plane has eigenvalues 1 and -p and the peripheral zero-sum complement has the scaled adjacency spectrum, including disconnected multiplicities. Detailed balance and triangles yield the exact weighted-L2 rate. Exact stationary variance and its derivative establish the wisdom optimum; two affine spectral branches establish the speed optimum. L>=1 from trace(A_H^2)=Nd implies distinct optima, a full nondominated interval and the exact variance price. The independent exact-matrix checker passed 145 cases. Finite checks support but do not prove the all-size theorem, which follows symbolically.

value.rationale: For every finite regular-base cone, the theorem classifies all Pareto-efficient popularity biases, not just a particular rate or numerical optimizer. Opposite-side wisdom and speed optima and an explicit variance penalty of order N for familiar windmill/friendship families quantify a natural structural tradeoff in DeGroot learning. The motivation is the published tension between social wisdom and consensus speed; the exact loss is needed to evaluate policy/tuning choices in those network families.
